conventions.convention: Assume Countable Choice. Use restricted complete Euclidean Lebesgue spaces, componentwise finite-dimensional integrals, and almost-everywhere identification. Displayed iterated integrals mean joint integrals, with section integrals required only almost everywhere.

The weak-form domain is Ω × [0,T), in spatial-first coordinates. Local integrability includes compact sets meeting t=0. Initial data are prescribed independently of representative values on the null initial slice; the identity supplies no strong initial trace.

Tests vanish near the spatial boundary and final time. The equation uses integral(U·φ_t + F:∇φ + S·φ) plus the initial term equal to zero; the inequality ∂tH + div Q ≥ R uses the corresponding integral ≤ 0.

Traction is indexed by the outward unit normal and depends on the contact surface only through position and normal. The resultant balance is assumed on every relatively compact bounded C1 subdomain. Surface measure uses the Gram chart density.

Matrix divergence is rowwise, L_ij = ∂j u_i, and A:B is the entrywise contraction. Traction is σν; heat flux q·ν is positive outward. Stress power therefore enters the conservative energy flux as −σᵀu.

Jump coordinates are time-first, identified with the weak definition by a measure-preserving coordinate permutation. The plus side is x3 > h, [G] = G+ − G−, n = (−∇h,1)/sqrt(1+|∇h|²), and Vn = h_t/sqrt(1+|∇h|²). Sources contain no interface-supported measure.

load_bearing.statement: For locally integrable U, F, S on Ω × [0,T) and locally integrable U0 on Ω, ∂tU + div_x F = S with distributional initial datum U0 means integral(U·φ_t + F:∇φ + S·φ) + integral(U0·φ(·,0)) = 0 for every prescribed compactly supported C1 test. The scalar inequality uses nonnegative tests and the corresponding integral ≤ 0. All measure, support, initial-data and integrability conventions in the Definition apply.

Under the stated Countable Choice, C2 orientation-preserving material motion, positive C1 density, C1 fields near swept material closures, continuity equation, C1 Cauchy stress and material integral balances, linear momentum is equivalent to its conservative equation; angular momentum additionally is equivalent to stress symmetry. The stated kinetic identity holds, and total energy is equivalent to its conservative equation and, after subtracting kinetic energy, to the internal-energy equation.

Under Countable Choice and the stated C1 graph, piecewise C1 fields with C1 one-sided extensions, coordinate and ordinary-source conventions, the interior weak equation holds if and only if the classical side equations hold and [F]n − Vn[U] = 0. The scalar interior weak inequality holds if and only if the side inequalities hold and [G]·n − Vn[H] ≥ 0.

For the stated C2 motion and local density/body fields, assume Countable Choice, orientation-local continuous locally uniformly bounded traction, and the displayed force balance on every relatively compact bounded C1 subdomain. Then there is a unique matrix σ(t,x) such that τ(t,x,n) = σ(t,x)n for every n ∈ S². The conclusion assumes ordinary surface traction without surface couples or curvature-dependent singular forces.

alerts.finding: Potential missing entropy-flux trace hypothesis. The Statement assumes primitive fields are 'C1 on each side' with C1 one-sided extensions, says 'T>0', and requires displayed products merely locally integrable. It then writes [ρsu+q/T] and applies lem-fd-weak-jump-consistency, which requires the composite flux itself to have C1 one-sided extensions. Positivity inside the sides does not ensure positive temperature traces. For example, near the plane z=0 take ρ=1, u=σ=e=s=b=r=0, q=z²e1 and T=|z|^(5/2) on both sides. Primitive fields have C1 extensions, all side balances and interior weak balances hold, and q/T=|z|^(−1/2)e1 is locally integrable, but that vector flux has no finite one-sided trace. If T>0 is intended to include both one-sided traces, this needs to be explicit; otherwise the stated jump expression and supplier application are unsupported for this admissible side-field example.
